Instruction: The larger left vehicle becomes smaller, but remains substantially larger than the right vehicle, which itself has been replaced. A successful edit would resize the existing large toy to match the existing small car; most of this size-match requirement is unmet. Quality: Structural coherence, lighting, shadows and toy surfaces are satisfactory; both cars are recognizable and coherent without clear generation artifacts.

Instruction: Additional weight-like material appears on the left, but it forms an unusual elevated platform and stacked structure instead of a straightforward added weight beside the original. The requested addition is only partially realized. Knowledge: The explanation requires two left weights and a leftward downward tilt.
